newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek money rates stable in late trade, fx inflows.
newsitem.headline: Greek money rates stable in late trade, fx inflows.

text.p: Ecu/drachma was hovering around 301, off an intraday low of 300.50/70 with more than 200 million ecus sold for drachmas at the Bank of Greece's fixing, in a show of confidence, dealers said.

Money rates and forex forwards were quarter of a point softer after a sharper drop in early dealing and dealers said the market had discounted a 20 basis point rate cut by the central bank in its overnight bid rate.
"The market gave a vote of confidence to the new government with more than 200 million ecus sold at the fixing," said a foreign bank dealer. "Ecu/drachma is trading around 301 in late dealing."
Other dealers said cash rates and forex forwards had stabilised at lower levels, about 25 basis points lower compared to Friday afternoon levels.
"Shorts have already factored in a 20 basis point cut in the intervention bid rate," said a money dealer at a foreign bank.
The central bank drained overnight funds at an unchanged 12.40 percent.
The mark was quoted at 158.08/18 drachmas from Monday's 158.130 fix, the dollar at 239.83/93 drachmas from 239.800 and the Ecu at 300.98/08 from 301.070 drachmas.
